title: Swarm: rotate the mTLS leaves (consul rolling, nomad parallel)
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate swarm --yes`. FORCES a fresh pki_int leaf on each node (rm the persisted bundle so the vault-agent pkiCert re-issues), restarts consul ROLLING (followers-first/leader-last) + nomad PARALLEL big-bang. Old vs new wire serials prove the rotation.

observe.what: 6-node table; new serial differs from old serial on every node; 0 errors

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.RotateCertAsync force-reissues the pkiCert leaves (a bare vault-agent restart reuses the cached cert), then restarts consul rolling and nomad parallel big-bang ([[nomad-tls-rolling-restart-must-be-parallel]]); serials are read on the wire via openssl s_client.
